name: @cortexkit/pi-anthropic-auth
description: Pi package for CortexKit Anthropic OAuth support. It replaces the implementation of Pi's built-in Anthropic provider, keeping the `anthropic` provider ID and model IDs, and is backed by the shared `@cortexkit/anthropic-auth-core` package.
